Deadliest Catch crews faced dangerous seas and tough waters this season. Watch as the U.S. Coast Guard rescues all nine crew members from the sinking Arctic Sea, while Captains Sig and Sophia hit the jackpot with hybrid crab, and more.

About Deadliest Catch:
Crab fishermen risk their lives as they battle Arctic weather, brutal waves and a ticking clock for big money in this modern-day gold rush on the Bering Sea.
